title: Microservices and serverless stories now score below the average story
question: Do stories that name microservices or serverless get fewer points than the average story in the latest 12 months?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Stories that name microservices or serverless get fewer points than the average story in the latest 12 months.
expect: If true, points per microservices/serverless story should be at most 0.8x the points of the average story in the same latest 12 months (0.95x counts as weak, 1.05x or higher refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story against the same-month average

group_b.label: Average story of the same months ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds written before this card was run. h303 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so the newest stories may still be gaining points.
Title words only: stories about microservices or serverless that never name them are missed.
Few stories match in 12 months, so one popular story can move the ratio.
